content: तर्क् €10 <ab>U.</ab> (तर्कयति-ते, तर्कित) .²1 To suppose, guess, suspect, believe, conjecture, infer; त्वं तावत्कतमां तर्कयसि <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; <ls>Me. 96</ls>. .²2 To reason, speculate about, reflect. दृष्ट्वा तत्सौकरं रूपं तर्कयामास चित्रधा <ls>Bhāg. 3. 13. 20</ls>. .²3 To consider or regard as (with two <ab>acc.</ab>) .²4 To think of, intend, mean, have in view; (पातुं) त्वं चेदच्छस्फटिकविशदं तर्कयेस्तिर्यगम्भः <ls>Me. 53</ls>. .²5 To ascertain; <ls>Rām. 3</ls>. .²6 To shine. .²7 To speak.
